description: This file defines the 'ConnectivityErrorResponse' class, which is an immutable Java class representing an error response related to connectivity commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It wraps exceptions thrown during command processing and provides methods for serialization/deserialization from JSON, as well as static factory methods for creating instances.

classes.name: ConnectivityErrorResponse
classes.description: An immutable Java class representing an error response for connectivity commands, wrapping a DittoRuntimeException and providing JSON serialization/deserialization, factory methods, and standard object overrides.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of ConnectivityErrorResponse from exceptions and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static methods to deserialize a ConnectivityErrorResponse from JSON string or object with associated headers.

methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.
